states.text: Order #48213 arrived with the screen cracked. Please send a replacement.
states.reply: Hello — I’m sorry your order ORD-48213 arrived with a cracked screen. We’ll help resolve this. Please reply with a photo of the damage and your preferred option (replacement or refund), and we’ll guide you through the next steps. Thank you for letting us know.

states.text: I was charged twice for ORD-10988, please refund the extra GBP 39.99.
states.reply: Hello — thank you for contacting Northwind Home about order ORD-10988. We’ve passed your refund request for the extra GBP 39.99 along for approval. We’ll update you as soon as we have news. If you have any other questions in the meantime, please let us know.

states.text: Where is my parcel? Tracking has not moved in 6 days. Order 77120.
states.reply: Hello — thank you for contacting Northwind Home about order ORD-77120. I’m sorry your tracking hasn’t updated. I’ll investigate this delivery issue and update you as soon as I have more information. If you’d like, I can also arrange a replacement or refund once we confirm the parcel’s status. Please let me know how you’d prefer to proceed.

states.text: The sofa from order 61234 has a torn seam. I want my money back, GBP 649.
states.reply: Dear Customer, thank you for contacting Northwind Home about order ORD-61234. We’re sorry your sofa arrived with a torn seam. Your refund request for GBP 649 has been passed for approval. We will be in touch with any updates and next steps. If you have photos or further details to share, please reply to this message. Thank you for your patience.
